name: application-currency-converter
title: Currency Converter
description: Dual amount fields for currency conversion with a typed input, a derived read-only output, a swap button, and a rate/last-updated caption.
useWhen: Users need to convert an amount between two currencies using a live or periodically updated exchange rate.
The interaction is genuinely bidirectional — swapping which currency is the source vs. target should feel natural.
You want to show the underlying rate and its freshness alongside the converted value for trust.
avoidWhen: The rate is fixed and rarely changes — a simple computed display may be enough without dedicated swap/edit affordances.
You only need to display a price in one currency, not convert between two — use currency-input instead.
The conversion needs more than two currencies at once — this pattern is inherently a from/to pair; use a small table for multi-currency comparisons.
responsiveBehavior: The converter is a fixed max-w-xs column that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: The swap button has an explicit aria-label describing its action, not just an icon.
The read-only 'You receive' field uses the native readonly attribute so assistive tech announces it as non-editable, not just visually styled.
Both currency selects have visually hidden labels distinguishing 'From' and 'To' for screen reader users.

variants.title: Currency converter
variants.description: 500 USD converting to EUR at a live rate, with a swap button between the two fields and a rate/freshness caption.
accessibility: The computed receive amount updates in the same readonly field rather than requiring users to re-find a result elsewhere on the page.

variants.title: Currency converter (Dark)
variants.description: Currency converter adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Field, select, and caption colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
